Earlier reports indicated that WhatsApp was developing new chat themes, and this feature is now being gradually rolled out to iPhone users. Here are the details.

WhatsApp's new chat themes include dynamic wallpapers

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is rolling out five new chat theme categories: Featured, Nature, Dynamic, Minimalist, and Doodle. Two weeks ago, the site had already discovered clues about the new theme gallery in the app's code.

The site notes that "Featured" includes the "best themes" carefully selected by WhatsApp's design team; the "Nature" category "brings the outdoors into your chats"; "Dynamic" offers "wallpapers that move slowly in the background"; the "Minimalist" theme "applies a single color to your chats: white in light mode, black in dark mode"; finally, "Doodle" is WhatsApp's classic wallpaper featuring doodle patterns.

Below is WABetaInfo's description of "Dynamic" wallpapers, arguably the most eye-catching new feature:

WABetaInfo mentions that WhatsApp will automatically match conversation bubble colors based on the selected theme, and adds that, as with the rollout of other WhatsApp features, the new feature may not be immediately available to all users.
